desc:
CONTROLS :
Shift - Dash 
Ctrl - Slide 
F - Punch / Parry
Q - Grapple
LMB - Normal Fire
RMB - Alternate Fire (Applies to some weapons)

Shift + Space = Farther Jump!

Battlepath is currently in its testing phase! Fight through hordes of enemies that are obstructing your way through procedurally generated rooms, and get stronger after each run! 

NOTES : 
- ❗This game is still in testing for all platforms! Feel free to leave any input in the official group or server!
- 🐞 Bugs are to be expected! You can report bugs on available social platforms found in the group! (All feedback is appreciated!)
-  🔥 Inspired heavily by Hakita's Ultrakill and other existing Roblox games, such as Windforce Interactive's Combat Initiation!
